notes: Iteration 3: same 3 complex-query evals, run against the SKILL.md that now has a Complex queries section (operators, relation traversal, id-in-projection, expand size, per_page cap, no-aggregation / check-for-a-view).

Both configs 17/17 assertions this run; both produced every correct final answer. with_skill went from 16/17 (iter2) to 17/17 - the iter2 regression (eval 9 inlining 'hard' and the datetime as literals) is fixed: iter3 with_skill parametrized every value including the null-guard empty string ({:e}).

Qualitative gains the assertions don't fully score: (a) eval 10 with_skill kept 'id' in the fields projection from the first call and never hit the ~200-error; the baseline still fired the projection without 'id', ate the error, and retried. (b) eval 11 with_skill consulted the _submission_stats VIEW for the totals (skill now says to look for a *_stats view first); the baseline computed everything from raw rows.

Still not solved by the skill: the big-fetch context blow-up in eval 11. Even a narrow id+submitted_by projection over 3164 rows exceeds the MCP result token cap at per_page>=200, so the run spills to a file and aggregates with jq. That is arguably fine (it recovers and answers correctly) but the skill could say plainly: for a client-side tally over thousands of rows, expect the result to spill to a file and plan to post-process it.

Cost: with_skill mean 56.1k tok / 95s, baseline 43.2k tok / 78.6s. The skill's inspect-first + view-checking habit adds calls up front; on eval 11 with_skill still finished in fewer tool calls than baseline (19 vs 15 -- wait, more: 19 vs 15) but comparable wall time. n=1 per cell, treat directionally.

Recommendation: the section is doing its job on evals 9-10. For eval 11, tighten the 'large / grouped results' subsection with the file-spill expectation, and consider adding per_page<=150 as the practical projection page size.
